title: GeoDiff: a Geometric Diffusion Model for Molecular Conformation Generation
layout_note: One row of latent circles from noisy to clean, left to right, with ball-and-stick renders tucked under three of them; the reverse arrow is labelled above, and a dashed curved arrow below returns from the next state to the current one for the forward process.
grouping: A single wide, short strip with no containers; ellipses mark skipped steps. The circles of noisy states are filled grey, the final clean state is a white circle — fill alone separates data from noise.
shapes_depth: Circles with thick black outlines holding bold italic math (C^T, C^t, C^{t-1}, C^0); solid black arrows; conditional-probability labels in italic math. Molecules are 3-D ball-and-stick renders in grey with a red oxygen and white hydrogens: a tangled structure under the noisiest state, a ghosted trail of several overlapping translucent copies that fade into a solid molecule under the intermediate state, and the clean molecule under the final state.
proposed_highlight: The model appears only as the subscript-theta reverse transition labelled over the central arrow; no colour or box marks it.
lesson: Show what a denoising step does to the geometry as a ghosted trail of overlapping translucent molecule copies fading into the solid one, placed under the chain's latent circles, and fill clean-data circles white against grey noisy ones.
notes: Venue read on the PDF first page ('Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2022'; venue_source: pdf). The molecule renders are embedded images recorded by refs crop and left out of the palette.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: One wide strip of state circles C^T ... C^t, C^{t-1} ... C^0 from left to right with ball-and-stick molecules tucked under three of them; no containers.
insights.data: Molecules are 3-D ball-and-stick renders: a tangled one under C^T, a ghosted trail of translucent overlapping copies near C^{t-1}, and a clean fused-ring molecule under C^0.
insights.emphasis: Fill alone separates noise from data: noisy states are grey circles and the final clean state is white; the conditioning on the graph G appears in the reverse label p_theta(C^{t-1}|G, C^t).
insights.flow: Solid arrows run left-to-right for the learned reverse process with its label above; a dashed curved arrow beneath returns from C^{t-1} to C^t for the forward q.
insights.avoid: Like most diffusion teasers it omits the denoising network, so it cannot serve as a model figure on its own.

arrangement.units: one unframed horizontal chain with renders under selected states
arrangement.inputs_as: grey noise state C^T with a tangled molecule render
